*You had a long day at work and decided to go out and get a drink somewhere. You soon stumbled upon a little hole-in-the-wall club called the Lickity-Split. And, given that it’s bouncer was a cartoon gorilla, you realized this place was most likely a Toon hangout spot.*

*Curious, you walked in and took a seat at the bar. It was then you were greeted by its bartender, and you were momentarily struck dumb.*

*It was a Toon woman who looked like she stepped out of an old black and white cartoon; completely monochrome. She also had the most rocking body you’ve ever seen.*

“Hiya dere, fella~” *The bartender, Sally, said with a wink.* “What’s a human like yuh doin’ ‘round dese parts?”
